races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Cloughleagh Bridge
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal cost 37,000euros; sister to Key To Cotai (Listed-placed 5f 2yo/7f; RPR 97); dam 5f-7f 2yo winner (85); stable 0-63 with 2yos.

runners_data.name: Lily Bear
runners_data.spotlight: Ninth foal; 25,000euros yearling; half-sister to six winners inc Solent Gateway (1m2f-2m Flat inc AW, RPR 103; 2m hurdle); dam 7.5f-1m2f winner (inc Italian Group 1); travelled notably well when runner-up to Cashel Queen in 7f Naas barrier trial last month; hooded; respected.

runners_data.name: Caoch The Piper
runners_data.spotlight: Awtaad filly cost 40,000euros as a yearling; dam unraced half-sister to Sea Silk Road (1m6f Group 1), out of German 7.5f 2yo Listed winning half-sister to 1m6f Group 3 winner Oriental Eagle; market can guide.

runners_data.name: Dear Madam
runners_data.spotlight: Sottsass filly cost 21,000euros as a foal; half-sister to five winners inc Galles (UAE 1m1f-9.7f dirt), Longden (US 8.5f dirt/1m1f turf) and Golden Valour (7f-10.6f inc AW;); dam 1m winner; stable's sole 2yo runner this season won so worth monitoring.

runners_data.name: Epilogue
runners_data.spotlight: Awtaad filly cost 6,500gns; half-sister to seven winners; dam 1m-8.6f winner (inc AW; 102), half-sister to Dubai World Cup winner African Story; respectable third in 7f barrier trial at Naas last month; yard 2-42 with 2yos.

runners_data.name: Cashel Queen
runners_data.spotlight: Price increased to 46,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to French winner Gregolimo (1m2f/10.5f inc 2yo/AW/Listed; RPR 108); dam French 6f-7.5f winner; stuck to her task well when seeing off Lily Bear in 7f Naas barrier trial last month; top connections and receives 4lb from that filly here.

runners_data.name: Celtic Moon
runners_data.spotlight: Thunder Moon filly; 20,000euros vendor yearling; dam French 10.5f/1m3f winner, half-sister to 1m5f Flat and useful 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner River Frost, out of unraced half-sister to 1m Group 2 winner Passing Glance; yard 0-14 with 2yos this year.

runners_data.name: Spanish View
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; 3,000euros yearling; half-sister to winners Nice Spirit (French 1m; RPR 83) and Artic Power (US 6f turf); dam placed 1m in France (78); stable 0-165 with 2yos; best watched.

runners_data.name: Pisiffik Ginger
runners_data.comment: Cotai Glory filly cost 22,000euros as a foal; market best guide on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Cotai Glory filly made a satisfactory debut when fourth of eight at Fairyhouse (6f, good) a fortnight ago, doing best work at the finish; bred to get much further so this trip should help.

runners_data.name: Star Glory
runners_data.comment: Never nearer sixth on debut, should improve, go well if acts on likely softer ground
runners_data.spotlight: Offered something to build on with never-nearer 5.25l sixth of 12 on debut at the Curragh (6f, good) after getting upset in the stalls; should improve for that and could go well if acting on softer ground.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden

runners_data.name: Cromac Quay
runners_data.comment: 33-1 for Leopardstown debut over this trip, got the message late on when promising third
runners_data.spotlight: Bit green but got the message late on when third on her course debut (1m, good to yielding; runner-up won the Oaks last weekend); beaten odds-on favourite when second at Naas next time (1m, good); sets a good standard.

runners_data.name: Banish Misfortune
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; 1,000euros vendor yearling; dam unraced sister to 1m-1m4f Flat and 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Snookered, out of 1m winner; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Blooming Rose
runners_data.spotlight: Blue Point filly cost 850,000euros as a yearling; closely related to smart 1m-1m2f winner Botanical (RPR 117), half-sister to last weekend's impressive Coronation Cup winner Bay City Roller; dam 1m2f-1m6f winner (inc Listed); easy winner of 7f Naas barrier trial last month; could be exciting.

runners_data.name: Ebony Reign
runners_data.spotlight: Ten Sovereigns filly; 32,000euros yearling; sister to 6f 2yo winner Leonardo Dax (RPR 91), closely related to 5.7f turf/6f AW winner Apache Star (81); fourth to Blooming Rose in Naas barrier trial; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Lecale Breeze
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; 1,000euros yearling; closely related to Italian 7.5f winner Tosca Galaxy but makes little appeal here; tongue-tied.

runners_data.name: Siesta Senorita
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal cost 8,000euros; dam well beaten 6f-1m, half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 3 winner Royal Razalma, out of Listed-placed 7f winner; can only be watched.

runners_data.name: Sydney Dollars
runners_data.comment: E40,000 Mehmas filly, dam 6.5f-7f winner, market can guide on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Mehmas filly cost 40,000euros as a yearling and was heavily supported late on in the betting on 1m debut at Naas last month but lost all chance with a slow start; still early days and she's worth monitoring.

runners_data.name: Into Tomorrow
runners_data.comment: St Mark's Basilica filly; yard's more likely of two newcomers, worth a market check
runners_data.spotlight: Respectable fourth of 12 on her Cork debut last month (7f, soft to heavy) when beaten 8.5l; will need to take a significant step forward to land this.

runners_data.name: Make The Tide
runners_data.comment: From off the pace she finished in midfield at Leopardstown (1m), showing some promise
runners_data.spotlight: Came from off the pace to finish midfield on her course debut (1m, good); made little impression 11 days later at Dundalk (7f); looks one for another day.

runners_data.name: Expert Dancer
runners_data.comment: Consistent in maidens, third on latest in a race won by a filly who is now Group 3-placed
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent in maidens, making the frame on all four occasions (best RPR on soft to heavy); ran below best on handicap debut at the Curragh (1m, good) in a visor (disgarded); each-way player back on a softer surface.

runners_data.name: Miss Moore Cen
runners_data.comment: Will need to step up a lot on midfield finish at the Curragh on debut when behind Cactus
runners_data.spotlight: Midfield finish on debut at the Curragh (6f, soft); not a bad effort when fifth of 14 at Down Royal (7f, good) 13 days ago but likely to fall short in this lineup.

runners_data.name: Quafftide
runners_data.spotlight: Not a bad run on debut at the Curragh in May last year but regressed at Naas in October; 243 days off.

runners_data.name: Slaney View
runners_data.spotlight: Showed ability on all three maiden starts at 5f-7f, including on soft; failed to beat a rival home in C&D Group 3 next time; nearer last than first on Curragh handicap debut; cheekpieces need to spark a revival.

runners_data.name: Mullacurry Maid
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to stable's nine-time winner Ducky Mallon but no impact in three maidens last year.

runners_data.name: Monamie
runners_data.comment: Never recovered from a slow start on recent Roscommon debut; best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Never recovered from a slow start on Roscommon debut; 400-1 when tailed off at Fairyhouse; will likely be aimed at handicaps.

runners_data.name: Loingseoir
runners_data.comment: Durable veteran, 7-74, placed 13 times, two mid-division runs this season, retains ability
runners_data.spotlight: Largely consistent veteran, 7-74 in his career and made the frame on three visits to this track, including seven days ago when 5l fourth to Bella Isabella; handles soft; needs things to fall right given how he's ridden; drawn wide; each-way chance if granted a solid pace to aim at.

runners_data.name: Free Solo
runners_data.comment: Has been out of form since C&D win last August, signs of a revival at the Curragh recently
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time winner, including here as a 2yo; ran well here twice last summer but has been out of form this term; 11th of 15 at Roscommon 24 days ago; down 4lb and hard to recommend.

runners_data.name: Tawaazon
runners_data.comment: 9-time winner absent since July and looks to have a bit to find with some of these
runners_data.spotlight: Nine-time winner, latest over a year ago at Naas (6f, gd) off 3lb higher before good third at the Curragh; returned from layoff to be beaten 10l in claimer at Fairyhouse 14 days ago; that leaves him with plenty to find up in trip.

runners_data.name: Are You In Or Out
runners_data.comment: C&D winner, new yard, lacks a run but has gone well fresh, check the market
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner last April for Paul Stafford off 13lb lower; positive start for new yard when staying on strongly to land Fairyhouse handicap (6f, good) 14 days ago by 0.5l off a seven-month layoff; up in trip and 4lb higher; handles soft; should go well again.

runners_data.name: Charming Whisper
runners_data.comment: Player judged on 5 wins in Britain on decent ground but out of sorts at the Curragh
runners_data.spotlight: Won five times in Britain, latest in August; shaped well a couple of times on the AW for this stable but didn't beat a rival home the last twice on turf, slowly away both times; down 3lb.

runners_data.name: Racing Royalty
runners_data.comment: Has typically shown his best form late in the season, may take a while to hit a peak again
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time winner on soft ground in 2023; signs his turn could be near again when placed at Galway in September before two below-par runs over a mile; drop in trip and ground will suit; off 241 days.

runners_data.name: Shoot To Kill
runners_data.comment: Thrown in on last year's form and eyecatcher last time; has his ground; big chance
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins last year on good ground, including at Roscommon off 80; bounced back to form with encouraging third at same track last month before backing that up under positive ride at Down Royal 13 days ago when 1.5l second to Faoladh; definitely capable off this mark but soft ground a concern.

runners_data.name: Green Kite
runners_data.comment: Didn't feature on Limerick comeback run and looks to have a bit to do on ratings
runners_data.spotlight: Best run in six efforts came in Killarney maiden (1m, soft) in October when 5.5l to Lady Lilac; mild signs of promise in two runs this term, latest at Gowran Park 22 days ago when beaten 3.25l into fourth over 7f on good to yielding in a claimer; dropped 4lb and Colin Keane takes over for yard in good form; could be on a nice mark and each-way chance.

runners_data.name: Lar Na Coille
runners_data.spotlight: Best run in three maidens came at Navan (6f, soft) in October when beaten 7l into sixth by Michael's Well; down the field at the Curragh 53 days ago; bred to appreciate step up in trip and opening mark looks reasonable.

runners_data.name: Meriden
runners_data.comment: 7f Down Royal winner last week; may find a few too good over this trip under a 7lb penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Improved for switch to handicaps last month and dropped back to this trip to good effect when scoring at Down Royal; followed up under a penalty dropped to 6f at the Curragh eight days ago easily by 3.5l in a good time; now 14lb higher but she's lightly raced and hard to know her ceiling; not guaranteed to handle soft but leading player nonetheless.

runners_data.name: Fortuity
runners_data.comment: Much improved back on better ground at Roscommon recently; mark unchanged and a contender
runners_data.spotlight: Improved for switch to handicaps and good ground when second at Roscommon last month before going one better at Fairyhouse (7f, gd) 14 days ago when making all to beat Elly Bay by 0.5l, showing good attitude after racing keenly; up 5lb and improving but soft ground a negative.

runners_data.name: Minaun View
runners_data.comment: Maiden after 15 starts; running well without really threatening; place shout
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden after 16 starts; best efforts have come on the AW; has found some consistency on turf the last three times; beaten 2l into sixth at Down Royal (7f, gd) 13 days ago despite being keen; dropped 1lb; soft ground a question mark.

runners_data.name: Zheleznaya Dama
runners_data.spotlight: Much-improved effort on fifth run when going close to landing a gamble at Down Royal (7f, gd) in September, beaten 2l into third by Sovereign Thought; travelled through the race like she was well treated; up 4lb and off 279 days; soft ground an unknown.

runners_data.name: Dinamine
runners_data.comment: Won over 1m at Bellewstown last August, lost ground at the start on 6f seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time winner, including over this trip on heavy at Gowran Park last year off 8lb lower; latest win at Bellewstown (1m, g/y) in August; satisfactory return over inadequate trip at Navan 26 days ago; 3lb drop generous and player with ground likely to suit.

runners_data.name: Only One Scobie
runners_data.comment: Beaten only a couple of rivals in two handicap efforts; remains opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Benefitted from return to soft ground, being dropped in the handicap and far more positive tactics when making all over a mile here seven days ago on his eighth start, winning cosily by 5l; has to recover quickly and probably will try dominate from the front again; obvious contender under a penalty but more on his plate down in trip.

runners_data.name: Sayfa Fad
runners_data.spotlight: Stayed on well to win Bellewstown handicap (1m, gd) in August but never landed a blow in two starts after; trainer has more obvious chance with Only One Scobie; off 254 days.

runners_data.name: Audience
runners_data.spotlight: Group 1 Lockinge winner in 2024 and Group 2 winner at Goodwood the same year; on a losing run since and ran poorly in Dubai in three starts this year; didn't fare any better at Haydock 33 days ago, fading tamely; hard to be positive about him currently.

runners_data.name: Native Warrior
runners_data.spotlight: Rediscovered his best with a visor added last summer, landing three handicaps, including at Ascot (7f, soft) off a mark of 103; cracking return when beaten 0.5l by Dreamliner in Group 3 at Saint-Cloud in March on soft; didn't come on as expected when beaten 7.5l into seventh by Wannabe Royal in Listed race at Naas 25 days ago; nothing got into it from off the pace that day so shouldn't be judged too harshly; handles soft and the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Zodiac Bear
runners_data.spotlight: Looked potentially smart when storming 4.25l clear in C&D maiden last year on second start; improved on that to be beaten 2l into third in this race last year, shaping particularly well on unfavoured side of the track; off since; open to plenty of improvement and a big player.

runners_data.name: Celestial Orbit
runners_data.spotlight: Ran nine times for Ollie Sangster, winning twice as a 2yo; best run for that stable came at Saint-Cloud (1m, heavy) when second in Listed; career-best on debut for this stable when winning Group 3 at the Curragh in April, worth more than the 0.5l winning margin suggests; backed up that run in less testing conditions when beaten 3l into seventh in Group 2 18 days ago; big shout back on favoured ground; down in trip.

runners_data.name: Redemption Road
runners_data.spotlight: Tipperary maiden winner last year over extended 7f on yielding; backed it up when second to the smart Limestone on heavy at Listowel; returned this term with a clear career-best when 3.25l third to Thesecretadversary in Group 3 over C&D; didn't back that up last time out at the Curragh but each-way chance with conditions to suit down in trip.

runners_data.name: Wannabe Royal
runners_data.spotlight: Limerick maiden winner on soft; followed a poor run over 6f at Cork with a career-best at Naas (7f, gd) 25 days ago when making all in Listed race; needs to build on that and not guaranteed to do so; likely to go forward.

runners_data.name: Oh Cecelia
runners_data.spotlight: Cork maiden winner over 5f on good for Jack Davison last year; positive start for new stable when winning Naas handicap (5f, soft) in March, added another win in conditions race at Cork (5f, soft); cracking run when a head second to the very smart Havana Anna in Lacken Stakes 25 days ago having raced alone stands side; chance on that but step up in trip not guaranteed to suit.

runners_data.name: East Hampton
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came in Madrid Handicap at Naas (7f, soft) last year; best subsequent run came when beaten a neck by Diego Velazquez in Group 2 at the Curragh over same trip; started this year positively when 1.5l second to Big Gossey in Listed Gladness 75 days ago, deserving extra credit for where he came from; at his best on soft and big run expected.

runners_data.name: Coeur d'Or
runners_data.comment: Down to a nice mark but remains vulnerable at this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time winner but not since Irish Cambridgeshire win of 2024; definite encouragement on penultimate run at this track (1m2f) when beaten 3.5l in sixth; kept on well to take 1l third at Cork (10.5f, good to yielding) on latest; off a winnable mark and drop in trip is in this veteran's favour.

runners_data.name: Slieve Binnian
runners_data.comment: Yet to match pick of Irish form in Bahrain and may be thwarted by double-figure draw
runners_data.spotlight: Multiple turf/AW winner including over C&D; ran respectably returned to Bahrain in January but soundly beaten there twice since; prefers a quicker surface than what's forecast which is a concern.

runners_data.name: Abbey Actress
runners_data.comment: Solid form in handicaps, up against it on the figures here, best on very testing ground
runners_data.spotlight: Solid form in handicaps for John O'Donoghue; good efforts in handicaps at the Curragh (1m, soft to heavy) and at this course (1m2f, yielding to soft; had Couer d'Or behind) on first two runs for this stable; outclassed in Listed grade at Gowran but a big player if the ground deteriorates.

runners_data.name: Vega's Muse
runners_data.comment: Easy winner on return but follow-up attempt perhaps came too quickly; not discounted
runners_data.spotlight: Added second turf win when keeping on well to comfortably land course handicap (1m, good to yielding) on seasonal return; follow-up attempt under 7lb penalty came too quickly on softer ground; tailed off last time at Naas.

runners_data.name: Musical Act
runners_data.comment: Return to 7f to suit and yard going well; cheekpieces worn last twice now discarded
runners_data.spotlight: Won two Kempton novices at 7f/1m in 2023; close up in Grade 3 at Keeneland in April 2024; finished no better than fourth in seven runs (six on AW) since joining this yard and soft ground looks a negative.

runners_data.name: Clear Quartz
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 6-36 on turf with three of those at his beloved Galway; rounded off last year with midfield finish at that venue from a tough draw; handles the mud but usually needs the comeback run.

runners_data.name: Morse
runners_data.comment: Promise in Leopardstown maiden at two; creditable AW runs lately; handicap bow; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came at this course (1m, heavy) off 6lb higher in April 2024; regressive last season; returns from a layoff with plenty to prove; 1lb wrong.

runners_data.name: Moyassr
runners_data.comment: Much more effective AW performer; unproven over this far
runners_data.spotlight: Boasts a fine AW record (four wins) and gained a first turf victory under this rider at Fairyhouse (1m2f, good) a fortnight ago; must be respected off the back of that but sole run on soft previously was a poor effort and this is a much tougher assignment; 1lb wrong.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap

runners_data.name: Tachos
runners_data.comment: Fifth behind today's rival Pink Oxalis at Leopardstown last September, lacks a recent run
runners_data.spotlight: Won over C&D (good) around this time last year from 8lb lower; missed the break on her return at Gowran 10 days ago when 16l behind Spanish Temptress; wouldn't want it too soft.

runners_data.name: Spanish Temptress
runners_data.comment: Went up an aggregate 21lb for three handicap wins last season, had an off day on latest
runners_data.spotlight: Went up an aggregate 21lb for three handicap wins last season; unlucky in two of her last three outings, beaten a nose at Limerick (1m, yielding) in April and just failed at Gowran (9.5f, yielding) 10 days ago; enjoys testing conditions; another big run on the cards.

runners_data.name: Speckled Meadow
runners_data.comment: Four-time h'cap winner; out of depth on return; this more realistic but others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner; added her fourth handicap win at Naas in October (10.5f, yielding) off 63; out of her depth on return at Cork before midfield in Naas handicap last month; chance if near her best.

runners_data.name: Great Mover
runners_data.comment: Only one win from 20 starts, has failed to retrieve her best form in four races this term
runners_data.spotlight: Only win from 21 starts came on heavy ground at Gowran (9.5f) last September from 5lb lower; failed to retrieve her best form in first four outings this term, but beaten only 1.25l when third at this course (7f, soft) last week and the step up in trip is a plus.

runners_data.name: Justenzia
runners_data.comment: 4lb swing for 2l defeat to Satono Chevalier latest, rain a plus, could turn tables
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win off 15lb lower at Clonmel last September (9.5f, soft); runner-up first two starts this term at 9.5f-1m5f; tailed off at Gowran 10 days ago; forecast rain a plus; could bounce back.

runners_data.name: Marmeladova
runners_data.spotlight: Went close in 1m Navan maiden on the third of five starts last season; a revelation on reappearance at Ballinrobe, winning very easily from an 85-rated favourite; poor run last time at Gowran but could be well treated on handicap debut for all soft ground is an unknown.

runners_data.name: Lady Chartwell
runners_data.comment: Won over 1m2f in Britain; two very poor runs for this yard; look elsewhere
runners_data.spotlight: Won 1m2f Chelmsford handicap for Charlie Johnston last year; inconsistent record subsequently and she beat just one rival home on her first two runs for current yard; Irish turf debut.

runners_data.name: Anvika
runners_data.comment: No win since June 2024, fine premier handicap run last year, poor so far this season
runners_data.spotlight: No win since June 2024; standout effort last year a fine second in premier fillies' handicap at this venue (1m, good to yielding); 5lb lower here but hard to fancy on this season's efforts and testing conditions also a worry.

runners_data.name: Lamberella
runners_data.comment: Caught the eye making late gains latest, potential improver on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to threaten in three maidens at 7f-1m but did catch the eye making late gains at Limerick on third start (7f, yielding); made no impact on 7f handicap debut at the Curragh last month; up in trip.

runners_data.name: Electric Beauty
runners_data.comment: Began the season with a Curragh win, has been kept busy, may find a few too good
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner; has been busy this year; fit from AW when winning at the Curragh (1m, heavy) in March; has largely remained in good form since, given a forceful ride at Roscommon (10.5f) on latest when finishing second; can go well dropped 1lb.

runners_data.name: Finsceal Annie
runners_data.comment: Two wins last season at Leopardstown, is 9lb above her last success, poor run latest
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice last season, both at this venue (7f, good to soft) including on this card; remains 5lb above her last win and her first two runs of the season offered little, but the yard had two winners at Roscommon on Monday so watch the betting.

runners_data.name: She's Ideal
runners_data.comment: Maiden has been in good form this season, good run over C&D latest, 1lb lower now
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden but she's generally been running consistently this season; early traffic problems when third at Fairyhouse last month puts her right in the picture; not at her best there six days ago; blinkers; 2lb wrong.

runners_data.name: Rocket Robyn
runners_data.comment: Second in a 1m1.5f maiden here last autumn; below that level twice since; needs her best
runners_data.spotlight: Best run came when close second in Gowran maiden (9.5f, heavy) last autumn; well below that level since, including on handicap debut at that venue on latest; tongue-tie is reached for now.

runners_data.name: Codice
runners_data.comment: Signs of ability on Flat in France but poor in two Irish runs inc' over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some ability on the Flat in France last year without winning but has been poor in three Irish runs, including over hurdles twice for this yard; best watched.

runners_data.name: Launch Time
runners_data.comment: Leopardstown winner up 7lb but could well handle it
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came on eighth run when landing a mile handicap at this course in April (good), beating Cleopatra's Needle by 0.75l; ran to a similar level at Cork 48 days ago when beaten 3l into fourth; 7lb rise seemed to anchor him that day but another good run can be expected dropped 1lb.

runners_data.name: Rampage
runners_data.comment: Last turf win was in 2023, two AW wins since then, unplaced favourite at Dundalk on latest
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time winner, last turf win in 2023 over this trip at Galway on soft; two AW wins since; beaten 9.5l into seventh at Gowran Park 22 days ago (1m, good); cheekpieces back on and handles soft but mark looks a bit high.

runners_data.name: Slaney Swagger
runners_data.comment: 0-20 on turf, placed on ten occasions, limited AW experience, ground-versatile on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden on turf after 20 runs; placed five times last year on good and heavy but finished on a low note with a below-par run on the AW; off 183 days and makes stable debut dropped in trip; will handle the ground and is capable off this mark.

runners_data.name: Roderick
runners_data.comment: Five-time winner, decent form last summer, never involved over C&D on seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time winning veteran; last win came at Naas (1m, yielding) last July off 1lb higher; on a decent mark but not much encouragement to be taken from return to turf 63 days ago when 12th at Gowran Park.

runners_data.name: Porsche Lad
runners_data.comment: Arrives here in good form; solid fourth over 7f last week on stable debut; trip a plus
runners_data.spotlight: Been running consistently well on the AW for over a year, landing two handicaps, latest in November off this mark; beaten favourite 104 days ago when 2.75l behind Daonethatgotaway over 1m4f; four turf runs have been poor and soft ground unlikely to suit; drawn wide.

runners_data.name: Medieval Night
runners_data.comment: Minor step in right direction at Gowran latest, more needed in new headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Encouraging run on handicap debut after a break when 1.5l second over C&D in August off 8lb higher; nothing of note in five starts after but fared better under positive tactics when 7l eighth at Gowran Park (1m, yielding) 10 days ago; still a fair bit to do.

runners_data.name: Secret Magician
runners_data.comment: Didn't get a clear run when third last time; remains on a nice mark if backing it up
runners_data.spotlight: Last turf win came at Naas in August 2024 over 7f on good; signs he could capitalise on sliding mark when close third at Killarney (1m, good) in May but disappointing favourite at Listowel 11 days ago; step up in trip should suit but becoming hard to predict.

runners_data.name: Khormor Syd
runners_data.comment: Runner-up twice last month; 3lb higher but big player and trip could be ideal
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden in ten runs but has threatened to break it the last two times when runner-up at Gowran Park (9.5f, soft) and Limerick (1m4f, yielding); unlucky last time having hit the front and nailed on the line; up another 3lb but ground will suit and can go close again.

runners_data.name: Nibras Rainbow
runners_data.comment: Four-time winner but needed to run better on recent yard debut to be seriously considered
runners_data.spotlight: Followed a poor effort at Cork with a 33-1 surprise win at Killarney (1m, good) 30 days ago, holding on by a short head with Secret Magician in third; stays well and finished second three times in testing conditions last year so a definite player off 4lb higher.

runners_data.name: Rockbury Lad
runners_data.comment: Reserve; won off 6lb higher last year; latest run was not encouraging
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner who shaped well in a C&D handicap in August when eighth off 7lb higher mark; placed on the AW twice in last three runs but below-par effort here over a mile 27 days ago; soft not likely to suit.

runners_data.name: Nephin Mountain
runners_data.comment: Two good runs in 7f handicaps at Gowran and stayed on steadily last time; trip may help
runners_data.spotlight: Two best runs in six starts came at Gowran Park over 7f on soft, finishing fourth in pair of handicaps in April either side of a less appealing run at Bellewstown; handles soft and shaped as if this trip could be within reach last time.

runners_data.name: Staywitherjohnny
runners_data.comment: Ran her best race so far when third at 25-1 over C&D, deserves to be a prime fancy now
runners_data.spotlight: Step in the positive direction on seventh start when beaten 4.25l into third by Majestic King at Gowran Park (1m, good); failed to back that up at same track 22 days ago when ninth; steps up in trip, lightly raced and trainer in good form.

runners_data.name: Ella's Gold
runners_data.comment: Went close in first two handicaps last Oct', off since, rain would boost chance
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced and improved for switch to handicaps when 1.5l second at Naas (1m, good) in September; went close again when beaten a neck up 4lb at Gowran Park after on heavy; ran poorly on return six days ago at Fairyhouse but slight drop back in trip and testing conditions could see her play a part.

runners_data.name: Colugo
runners_data.comment: Modest maiden on the level; keen-goer needs this run to get a handicap mark
runners_data.spotlight: 0-16 on the Flat, six on the turf; consistent on the AW during the winter and failed to make an impact in three hurdle runs since; ground a question mark; off ten days since finishing eighth in Listowel maiden hurdle.

runners_data.name: Rodeo Blues
runners_data.comment: Three moderate displays in maidens, may be competitive in this grade for a top stable
runners_data.spotlight: Three runs of little consequence in maidens but made more of an impression on handicap debut when beaten 6.25l into fourth at Gowran Park (9.5f, yielding) ten days ago, still looking green; likely to improve with racing and could figure for top stable.

runners_data.name: Hale Bopp
runners_data.comment: No win since 2023, decent third over C&D latest, place chance if backs that up
runners_data.spotlight: 2-34 on turf, last turf win in May 2022; been running fine this year without really threatening to win; placed at Gowran Park (1m, good) two starts ago; well held ten days ago; no obvious reason why he'd warrant support off same mark.

runners_data.name: Desert Of The Sea
runners_data.comment: Consistent form in defeat here this year and had excuses for latest seventh; player
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden in 17 starts but was placed on the AW three times this year and ran well from the front 83 days ago from a wide draw; low mark but hard to have too much confidence back on turf up in trip, especially on soft ground.

runners_data.name: Crackles
runners_data.comment: Not much to shout about in form for previous trainers; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Little promise in five maiden starts and down the field on handicap debut at Listowel 11 days ago; up in trip.

runners_data.name: Folk Warrior
runners_data.comment: No worthwhile form in maidens on the Flat and over hurdles; handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Showed little in first six starts on the Flat and over hurdles; plugged on reasonably well when fifth over 1m4f at Dundalk 16 days ago but hard to recommend.

runners_data.name: Garryowen Green
runners_data.comment: Towards the back at Dundalk last December, no better at Limerick last month, tongue-tie
runners_data.spotlight: Towards the back and little impression in three maiden runs; makes handicap debut off basement mark and hard to know what to expect.

runners_data.name: One For Teigan
runners_data.comment: No sign of winning potential, has been tried at this venue over a range of distances
runners_data.spotlight: No sign of promise in six starts in maidens from 7f to 1m4f; market support might pique interest but one to avoid otherwise on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Oreeda
runners_data.comment: Has made no impression in three handicap attempts, met trouble in running at Tipperary
runners_data.spotlight: Hard to find encouragement in four handicap runs thus far; not an obvious contender.
